_doc: Registered office of every forest co-operative in the ΔΑΣΕ dataset (DATA_DECISIONS 2026-08-24). `register` = the VIES record (the co-op's village, its Τ.Κ. and the reference town); `contract_seat` = the verbatim party clause of one of its own signed contracts, where one states a seat; `contract_pes` = the Π.Ε. of its contracts, used to validate a geocode, never as a stated seat. ΓΕΜΗ knows no forest co-op — they register in the ΥΠΕΝ Μητρώο Δασικών Συνεταιριστικών Οργανώσεων, which has no public API. Geocodes are added by scripts/geocode_dase_coop_seats.py.
